DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 新しい口座についてのご相談ですね。どのような目的でお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: You'd like advice about a new account. What will you use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 来月から市内の会社で働くので、給与を受け取る口座を作りたいです。会社から口座情報を今週中に出すよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 口座開設を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I'll start work at a company in the city next month, so I'd like an account to receive my salary. The company told me to submit the account details by the end of this week.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask about opening an account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 給与受取のご希望ですね。お申込みには本人確認やご利用状況の確認が必要です。在留カードはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: For receiving salary, then. An application requires identity and usage checks. Do you have your residence card?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 持っています。在留期間は来年までですが、入社前なので社員証はまだありません。採用通知ならあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 本人確認と勤務先確認の準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Yes. My period of stay runs until next year, but I haven't started work, so I don't have an employee ID yet. I do have the employment offer notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain your preparations for identity and employment verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 勤務先を確認する資料として使えるか、担当で確認します。口座がいつ使えるかは、確認や審査の状況にもよります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: The person in charge will check whether that can be used to verify your employer. When the account becomes usable also depends on the checks and review.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今週中に必ず間に合うとは限らないのですね。会社には、申込み前に必要書類を確認していると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 確約されていない期限を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: So it isn't guaranteed to be ready this week. I'll tell the company I'm checking the required documents before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Understand that the deadline has not been guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そのようにお伝えください。会社で受取口座に指定があるかも確かめておくと、行き違いを防げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Please tell them that. Checking whether the company specifies a salary account will also help prevent misunderstandings.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 銀行名の指定は聞いていませんでした。今ここで会社に連絡してから、申込みの説明を受けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 必要な口座の条件を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I hadn't asked whether they specify a bank. May I contact the company here first and then hear the application explanation?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check the requirements for the account you need. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: どうぞ、こちらの待合でご確認ください。戻られたら、必要書類と申込方法を担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Please do, in this waiting area. When you return, the person in charge will explain the required documents and application method.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 会社への確認が済んだら戻ります。提出期限も相談し、採用通知を担当の方に見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 申込みに向けた次の行動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I'll come back after checking with the company. I'll discuss the submission deadline too and show the employment offer notice to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide the next steps toward applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、お戻りになりましたら窓口へお声がけください。私は担当者へご相談の内容を引き継ぎます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Then please speak to the counter when you return. I'll pass your consultation details to the person in charge. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大きなお荷物の移動についてですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about moving large luggage?

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二つを一度に運べません。一つを改札の中へ置いて、もう一つを取りに戻るつもりです。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの荷物を改札内に置いて往復する計画を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can't carry both pieces at once. I was planning to leave one inside the gates and come back for the other.
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to leave luggage inside the ticket gates and make two trips. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物を無人で置く計画は避けてください。お二人とも列車へ乗られますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please avoid leaving luggage unattended. Are both of you taking the train?

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。友人は外で待っています。私だけが往復すればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 双方が乗車予定で友人は改札外にいると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My friend is waiting outside. I thought I could just make the trips myself.
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say both of you plan to board and your friend is outside the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お二人で荷物を持ち、通れる経路を相談しましょう。友人は荷物を一つ持てますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's discuss a route the two of you can use while carrying the luggage. Can your friend carry one piece?

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持てます。途中で渡すのでなく、改札の外で一つずつ分けてから進みたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外で荷物を一つずつ分担すると提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than hand it over along the way, I'd like us to take one piece each outside the gates before proceeding.
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Propose sharing one piece each outside the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの広い通路を使う経路をご案内できます。階段のある近道は避ける希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can show you a route using this wide passage. Would you prefer to avoid the shortcut with stairs?

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。二人が離れず、一つずつ運べる経路を知りたいです。最短でなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一緒に運べる階段を避けた経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'd like a route where we can stay together and each carry one piece. It doesn't have to be the shortest.
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a stair-free route where you can carry the luggage together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経路と、乗場までの移動を案内します。荷物を係員へ預けるサービスではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain that route and how to reach the boarding area. This is not a service for leaving luggage with staff.

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。私たちで各一つを持ち、置いたまま戻る計画はやめます。友人をここへ呼びます。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 係員へ預けず共同で運ぶ計画へ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We'll each carry one and abandon the plan to leave one and go back. I'll call my friend here.
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Change to carrying the luggage together rather than leaving it with staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お二人そろいましたら、通路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-TKY-STA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once both of you are here, I'll show you the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの麺をお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to buy these noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。温かい昼食にしたいので、弁当と一緒に全部温めてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 弁当と冷やし麺を同じように温めたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like a hot lunch, so could you heat everything, together with the boxed meal?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to heat the boxed meal and chilled noodles the same way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは温める商品ではありません。この場面では冷たいまま食べる麺です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-03.translation: This isn't a product for heating. These noodles are meant to be eaten cold here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 容器が弁当に似ていても、同じ扱いではないのですね。袋のつゆだけなら温められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器の見た目では扱いが決まらずつゆだけの加熱も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-04.translation: So similar-looking containers don't mean they're handled the same way. Could you heat just the sauce packet?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that appearance does not determine handling and ask about heating only the sauce. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品のつゆも、こちらでは温めません。温かい食事でしたら別の商品をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-05.translation: We don't heat this product's sauce here either. If you'd like a hot meal, I'll show you a different product.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今日は温かさを優先します。麺でなくても、一人分を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 温かい一人分を優先して別商品を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Warm food is my priority today. I'd like one portion, even if it isn't noodles.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize one hot portion and request another product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 温める案内があるご飯の商品はこちらです。ふたを開ける前に、会計時にお申し付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are rice products with heating instructions. Please ask at checkout before opening the lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ではこちらを一つにします。冷たい麺は開けていませんので、お渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未開封の麺を渡し代替一つを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll take one of these. I haven't opened the cold noodles, so I'll hand them back.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Return the unopened noodles and choose one alternative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりします。持ち帰りですか、店内で召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take them. Is this takeaway or for eating in?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち帰りです。選び直した一つだけを会計して、その商品の案内どおりに温めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持帰りと会計対象と加熱する商品を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-10.translation: Takeaway. Please charge me only for the one replacement product and heat it according to that product's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm takeaway, the item to charge, and the product to heat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。冷やし麺は会計に含めず、ご飯の商品をご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-002-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We won't include the chilled noodles in the bill; we'll prepare the rice product.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 購入された食品についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about food you purchased?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。開けた時に、いつもと違うにおいがしました。傷んでいると私が判断したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開封時の違和感を商品状態の確定判断と分けて申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I opened it, it smelled different from usual. I'm not saying I've determined that it is spoiled.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the unusual smell on opening separately from any definite judgment of the product's condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 召し上がった分はありますか。購入後の状態も教えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you eaten any? Please also tell me what happened after purchase.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食べていません。昨日買い、帰宅後は表示を見て冷蔵庫へ入れました。移動中の温度は記録していません。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未食と保管経緯と移動温度の未記録を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't eaten it. I bought it yesterday and put it in the refrigerator after checking the label when I got home. I didn't record the temperature during the journey.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is uneaten, explain storage, and state that the travel temperature was not recorded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲の経緯を伺います。商品と包装はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask about the history as far as you know it. Do you have the product and packaging?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方あります。開封した袋は捨てず、別の袋へ入れて持ってきました。表示が読めるままです。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示付き包装と現物を保存して提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both. I kept the opened wrapper and brought it inside another bag. The label is still readable.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Preserve and show the product and packaging with its label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が現物と記録を確認します。残りの商品をほかの容器へ移したり、味見したりしないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will inspect the item and records. Please don't transfer the remaining product to another container or taste it.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。見てほしいのはこの一袋です。同じ日に買った別の商品も全部同じ状態とは言えません。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相談対象を一袋に限定し他商品へ一般化しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. This one bag is what I'd like checked. I can't say every other product bought that day is in the same condition.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit the inquiry to one bag without generalizing to other products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象を分けて確認します。ご希望の対応については結果と一緒にご案内します。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the items separately. We'll explain the response you request together with the result.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。においと未食の事実、保管の分かる範囲を伝え、扱いの説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認可能な事実で担当の説明を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll give the smell, the fact it's uneaten, and what I know about storage, then wait for the handling explanation.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide confirmable facts and wait for the responsible person's explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品と包装をお預かりして確認します。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take the product and packaging to check them. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお値段についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about this price?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きい数字が百九十円なので、二百円以内で買えると思いました。レジでは二百五円と言われました。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本体百九十円を予算内総額と考えたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-02.translation: The large number is a hundred and ninety yen, so I thought I could buy it for under two hundred. At the register I was told two hundred and five yen.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you treated the hundred-and-ninety-yen base price as the total within your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この表示では大きい方が本体価格、下の二百五円が税込の支払価格です。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-03.translation: On this label, the large amount is the base price, and two hundred and five yen underneath is the payment price including tax.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 追加の品が登録されたのではないのですね。小さい文字の方を見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-04.hintJa: 税込表示を見落とし追加登録ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-04.translation: So an extra item wasn't registered. I hadn't looked at the smaller print.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you overlooked the tax-inclusive price and it was not an additional item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ商品の表示と会計を照合しています。予算は一品二百円までですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-05.translation: We've compared the label and checkout for the same item. Is your budget up to two hundred yen per item?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、今日はそれが上限です。税込二百五円から五円だけ引いてもらうのでなく、予算内の別の商品を探したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二百円の上限を示し値引きでなく予算内の別商品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, that's my limit today. Rather than asking you to take five yen off two hundred and five, I'd like another product within my budget.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the two-hundred-yen limit and request another item within budget rather than a discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示された支払価格で、別の商品も選べます。ご希望に合うものをご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-07.translation: You can choose other items by their displayed payment prices too. Shall I show you something suitable?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では支払総額が二百円以内の物を見ます。この商品の会計はまだ確定しないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-08.hintJa: 総額基準で選び直すため会計を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll look for something with a total payment of no more than two hundred yen. Please don't finalize this item's checkout yet.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold checkout while choosing again using the total price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらには税込百八十円の商品があります。内容量もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Here is a product costing a hundred and eighty yen including tax. Please check its quantity too.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 量は少し少ないですが今日は十分です。税込百八十円の一つへ選び直します。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-10.hintJa: 量を確認し税込百八十円の一つに変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-10.translation: It's a little smaller, but enough for today. I'll switch to one of those at a hundred and eighty yen including tax.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the quantity and switch to one item at a hundred and eighty yen including tax. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の商品は会計せず、選び直した一つを会計いたします。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUP-002-SHARED-11.translation: We won't charge for the original product; we'll ring up the one you've chosen instead.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 結果の受け取りに使う控えはこちらです。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the slip for collecting your results.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察券の番号と違います。この新しい番号を、今後の予約にも使えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 結果受取番号を新たな患者番号か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-02.translation: The number is different from my patient card. Should I use this new number for future appointments too?
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the results-collection number is a new patient number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この控えは今回の結果受け取り用です。診察券の番号を変更したものではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-03.translation: This slip is for collecting these results. It does not change your patient-card number.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族へ新しい患者番号だと送ってしまいました。受け取りの控えだと訂正します。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族へ誤った用途で伝えたと説明し訂正を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-04.translation: I already sent it to my family as a new patient number. I'll correct that and tell them it's a collection slip.
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you told your family the wrong purpose and decide to correct it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人が受け取る予定ですか、ご家族に依頼されますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-05.translation: Will you collect them yourself or ask your family?

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず自分で来る予定です。家族が番号を知っていても、代理受け取りを頼んだことにはなりません。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人受取予定と番号共有を代理依頼から区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-06.translation: For now, I plan to come myself. Even if my family knows the number, that doesn't mean I've asked them to collect on my behalf.
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your own planned collection and sharing the number from asking someone to collect for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 代理での受け取りが必要になれば、条件を先にご相談ください。控えは診察券と分けて保管できますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-07.translation: If proxy collection becomes necessary, ask about the conditions first. Can you keep this slip separately from your patient card?

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この検査の日を書いて、今回の控えと分かるようにします。受け取れる時期もまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回の控えを区別して保管し受取時期の未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll write the test date so I can identify it as this occasion's slip. I haven't checked when collection is possible yet either.
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep this slip identifiable and say the collection time has not been checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 結果担当へ時期と受け取り方を確認します。この番号だけで今日受け取れると判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the timing and collection method with the results department. Don't assume this number alone means you can collect today.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。番号の用途を家族へ直し、受け取り時期の説明を聞いてから控えをしまいます。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号用途と受取可能時期を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll correct the number's purpose with my family and put the slip away after hearing when I can collect.
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the number's purpose separately from when collection is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで担当者の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here for the person's guidance.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約変更のお問い合わせですね。回答は登録のメールへお送りします。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking to change an appointment. We'll send the response to your registered email address.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そのアドレスを今日使えなくします。変更をお願いした後なので、返事を受け取れないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-02.hintJa: 回答前に登録メールを使えなくする予定を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-02.translation: I'm making that address unusable today. Since I've already requested the change, I may not receive your reply.
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell them before the response that your registered email will become unusable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい予約日時は、まだ確定していません。別の回答方法をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-03.translation: The new appointment date and time aren't confirmed yet. Would you prefer another response method?

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。古いアドレスを削除してから待つのでなく、先に受け取れる方法へ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-04.hintJa: 削除前に別の回答方法へ変えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Rather than delete the old address and then wait, I'd like to switch first to a way I can receive your response.
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to change the response method before deleting the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人確認のうえ、連絡先の変更を担当へ相談します。新しいアドレスは用意されていますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-05.translation: After verifying your identity, we'll consult the person in charge about changing your contact. Do you have a new address ready?

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。ここに書きます。新しい連絡先を伝えることと、予約日時の変更が完了することは別ですね。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新連絡先の登録と予約変更の確定を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll write it here. Providing a new contact and completing the appointment change are separate things, right?
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish registering a new contact from confirmation of the appointment change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。連絡先を確認後、日時変更の結果をご案内します。今の予約は取り消したつもりですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Once the contact is checked, we'll tell you the result of the date change. Did you intend to cancel the current appointment?

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取り消したつもりではありません。変更先が取れるか確認中として、元の予約の扱いも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元予約を取り消した意図はないと伝え状態確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-08.translation: No, I didn't intend to cancel it. While we're checking whether another time is available, I'd also like to ask what happens to the original booking.
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you did not intend to cancel the original appointment and request a status check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方の状態を担当者へ確認します。返信を確認できるまで、元の日時を自己判断で消さないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check both statuses with the person in charge. Until you've confirmed the reply, don't remove the original date from your plans on your own judgment.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。回答先を整え、日時と元の予約の扱いが分かってから予定を更新します。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答経路と予約結果を確認して予定を更新する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll arrange a way to receive the reply and update my plans after I know the date and how the original booking is handled.
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the response channel and appointment result before updating your plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。まず新しい連絡先を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-HOS-002-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass this to the person in charge. First, let's check your new contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の説明書についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your medicine instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今回の紙をなくしました。家に同じ薬名の紙があったので、それを代わりに読んでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同名の古い説明書を今回の代わりに使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost the current sheet. I found a sheet at home with the same medicine name; may I read that instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether an old instruction sheet with the same medicine name can replace the current one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の処方と同じ内容か、薬剤師が確認します。その紙の日付はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pharmacist will check whether it matches the current prescription. What is the date on that sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 半年前です。錠剤の量の欄も今の袋と違います。名前が同じなので使えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用紙の日付と現在袋との量の差を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-04.translation: Six months ago. The tablet-dose field differs from my current bag too. I thought it could be used because the name was the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the sheet's date and the dose difference from the current bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 古い説明を今回の指示と決めず、現在の袋も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't assume the old instructions are the current ones. Please show the current bag too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。古い方に書いてある飲み方へ変えていません。今回の説明をもう一度受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 服用方法は変えていないと述べ今回の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I haven't changed to the dosage written on the old sheet. I'd like the current instructions explained again.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not changed your medicine-taking method and request the current explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬剤師へつなぎます。古い紙にはご自身で書き込んだ部分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll refer you to the pharmacist. Is there anything you wrote yourself on the old sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昼というメモがあります。前の説明の時に自分が書きました。今回の指示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昔の自分の書込みを今回指示と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's a note saying ‘noon.’ I wrote it during the previous explanation. It isn't a current instruction.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your old handwritten note from current instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その書き込みも区別して確認します。新しい説明書の用意についても相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll identify that note separately too. You can also discuss having a new instruction sheet prepared.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今回の袋と処方を照合し、説明書を受け取ってから古い紙とは別にしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現処方を照合した説明を受け新旧資料を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. After matching the current bag and prescription, I'll receive the instructions and keep them separately from the old sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive an explanation matched to the current prescription and separate the old and new documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 薬剤師が確認します。二つの用紙と袋はそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-005-001-SHARED-11.translation: The pharmacist will check. Please keep the two sheets and the bag as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座の用途欄には、勤務先の名前が書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've written your employer's name in the account-purpose field.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事のお金だからと書きましたが、会社の売上ではありません。自分が休日に販売する物の代金です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先名を書いたが自分の販売代金用だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote it because it's work-related money, but it's not the company's sales. It's payment for things I sell myself on my days off.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the employer name entry and explain that the account is for your own sales proceeds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の事業の取引を受けるご相談ですね。会社から開設を頼まれたわけではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you're asking about receiving transactions from your own business. Your company didn't ask you to open it, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、頼まれていません。勤務先が口座を管理する予定もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社からの依頼も会社管理の予定もないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct, they haven't asked. The company isn't planning to manage the account either.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that the company neither requested it nor plans to manage it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用途に合わせて確認する担当へご案内します。個人の生活費も同じ口座へ入れる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll guide you to the person who checks the intended use. Do you plan to put personal living-expense money into the same account?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ決めていません。売上の記録を分けたいので、案内を聞いてから使い方を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 生活費と売上の使い分けは案内後に決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't decided yet. I'd like to separate my sales records, so I want to decide how to use it after hearing the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will decide how to separate living expenses and sales after the guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望と確認事項を担当に伝えます。事業内容が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the person in charge your preference and the points to check. Do you have anything explaining your business?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 販売ページの写しがあります。勤務先の名刺ではなく、この活動の内容を示すために持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の活動資料を勤務先資料と区別して提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a copy of my sales page. I brought it to show this activity, not my employer's business card.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present information about your own activity separately from employer information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開設条件や必要資料は担当者から説明します。今日は相談だけをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain opening conditions and required documents. Do you only want advice today?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。用途欄を自分の活動として直し、条件を確認します。勤務先の業務用口座とは申告しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい用途へ直し条件確認だけを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll correct the purpose field to my own activity and check the conditions. I won't declare it as my employer's business account.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the intended use and request only a check of the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その用途の相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-006-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you to the person in charge for advice on that purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票の受け取りについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about collecting an item using a missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ部屋の郵便受けに入っていました。私の身分証を見せれば受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共用郵便受けの不在票を自分の身分証で使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It was in our shared apartment's mailbox. Can I collect it by showing my ID?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use a notice from a shared mailbox with your own identification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取人のお名前は、ご自身と同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the recipient's name the same as yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。同居人の名前です。同じ住所なら私の物として受け取れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居人名であり住所だけで本人扱いと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. It's my housemate's name. I thought the same address meant I could receive it as my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it names your housemate and you thought the address alone meant you could act as the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の郵便物ではないことを分けて確認します。同居人から受け取りを依頼されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll distinguish that it isn't your mail. Has your housemate asked you to collect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。本人へ知らせる前に来ました。代理を頼まれたと言うことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代理依頼は受けていないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I came before telling them. I can't say they asked me to act on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clearly state that you have not been asked to collect on their behalf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず受取人に確認してください。代理受取を希望される場合は、郵便物に応じた条件を担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with the recipient first. If they want proxy collection, ask the person in charge about the conditions for that mail item.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。この票を本人へ渡して、本人が受け取るか依頼するか決めてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 票を本人へ渡し受取方法を本人に決めてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll give the notice to the recipient and let them decide whether to collect it themselves or ask someone.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the notice to the recipient and let them decide the collection method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不在票は持ち帰ってください。こちらでは、今ご本人が受け取ったことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take the notice home. We won't treat the recipient as having collected it here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。私の受取記録として署名せず、同居人に届いた票だと説明して返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の受領として署名せず票を持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't sign to record receipt as my own. I'll explain that it was a notice for my housemate and give it back to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the notice home without signing as though you received your own item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要でしたら、受取人から手続きについてお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-007-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. If needed, the recipient can contact us about the procedure.
